+template <typename T>
+class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(const size_t count) : count_(count) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    T* get() { return data_; }
+    const T* get() const { return data_; }
+    size_t size() const { return count_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t count_ = 0;

+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

+        (other_diameter == choice.diameter && other_index < choice.index)) {

+        choice.index = other_index;

+template <int ITEMS>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void growCandidateClusters(const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                           unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                           const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,

+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {

+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
+        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else {
+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}
+
+} // namespace
+
+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

+// CUDA calls are deliberately fatal: this benchmark has no sequential fallback.
+// A CUDA failure therefore cannot silently change the parallelization approach.
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \
+    do {                                                                        \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_status_ = (call);                                \
+        if (cuda_status_ != cudaSuccess) {                                      \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__,       \
+                         __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(cuda_status_));            \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                            \
+        }                                                                       \
+    } while (false)

+template <typename T>
+class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(const size_t count) : count_(count) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    T* get() { return data_; }
+    const T* get() const { return data_; }
+    size_t size() const { return count_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t count_ = 0;
+};

+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

+        (other_diameter == choice.diameter && other_index < choice.index)) {
+        choice.diameter = other_diameter;
+        choice.index = other_index;
+    }

+void growCandidateClusters(const double* __restrict__ distances,

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           const double* distances,
+                           double* working_diameters,
+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,
+                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
+                           int* members) {
+    const dim3 grid(active_count);
+    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
+        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);

+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);

+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);

+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

+template <typename T>
+class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(const size_t count) : count_(count) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));

+    ~DeviceBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {

+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;

+    const T* get() const { return data_; }
+    size_t size() const { return count_; }

+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

+// One block independently grows one seed cluster. ITEMS candidates per thread
+// retain their running maximum diameter in registers across growth iterations.
+// This removes both the original repeated member scan and all working-matrix
+// traffic for the normal benchmark sizes.
+template <int ITEMS>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
+void growCandidateClusters(const double* __restrict__ distances,
+                           unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                           const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,
+                           int* __restrict__ candidate_members) {
+    const int active_index = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = active_seeds[active_index];
+    if (clustered[seed]) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
+    int* const seed_members =
+        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
+
+    __shared__ double shared_diameters[32];
+    __shared__ int shared_indices[32];
+
+    double max_diameters[ITEMS];
+    CandidateChoice local_choice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int item = 0; item < ITEMS; ++item) {
+        const int candidate = tid + item * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        double candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
+        if (candidate < point_count && candidate != seed && !clustered[candidate]) {
+            const double seed_distance =
+                distances[static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count + candidate];
+            if (seed_distance < threshold) {
+                candidate_diameter = seed_distance;
+                takeBetter(seed_distance, candidate, local_choice);
+            }
+        }
+        max_diameters[item] = candidate_diameter;
+    }
+
+    if (tid == 0) {
+        seed_members[0] = seed;
+    }

+        local_choice, shared_diameters, shared_indices);
+    int cardinality = 1;
+

+        const int newest_member = selected.index;
+        if (tid == 0) {

+        }

+        local_choice = CandidateChoice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};

+            double candidate_diameter = max_diameters[item];
+            if (candidate == newest_member) {

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,

+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,

+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

The final optimization removes the second growth of every winning seed: each seed writes its candidate member order once, and a lightweight commit kernel copies only the selected row. The default case is now about 12 ms versus the original 7,008 ms (roughly 584×), and every checked boundary hash remains identical. I’m doing one clean, from-scratch build and final validation now.

+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+

+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

+// Commit the selected row in parallel. All candidate member orders already
+// exist on-device, so the winning seed never needs to be grown a second time.
+__global__ void commitBestCluster(const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           const double* distances,
+                           double* working_diameters,
+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,
+                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
+                           int* members) {
+    const dim3 grid(active_count);
+    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
+        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
+        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else {
+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

+namespace {

+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+constexpr double INVALID_DISTANCE = DBL_MAX;
+
+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+}
+

+    double diameter;
+    int index;

+// Commit the selected row in parallel. All candidate member orders already
+// exist on-device, so the winning seed never needs to be grown a second time.
+__global__ void commitBestCluster(const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,
+                                  const int* __restrict__ candidate_members,
+                                  const int point_count,
+                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                  int* __restrict__ output_members) {

+        0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+    const int* const seed_members =
+        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
+
+    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < cardinality; i += blockDim.x) {
+        const int member = seed_members[i];
+        output_members[i] = member;

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           const double* distances,
+                           double* working_diameters,
+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,
+                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
+                           int* members) {
+    const dim3 grid(active_count);
+    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
+        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
+        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else {
+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}
+
+} // namespace
+
+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

   213	void growCandidateClusters(const double* __restrict__ distances,
   214	                           unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   215	                           const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
   216	                           const int point_count,
   217	                           const double threshold,
   218	                           unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,
   219	                           int* __restrict__ candidate_members) {
   220	    const int active_index = blockIdx.x;
   221	    const int seed = active_seeds[active_index];
   222	    if (clustered[seed]) {
   223	        return;
   224	    }
   225	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
   226	    int* const seed_members =
   227	        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
   228	
   229	    __shared__ double shared_diameters[32];
   230	    __shared__ int shared_indices[32];
   231	
   232	    double max_diameters[ITEMS];
   233	    CandidateChoice local_choice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};
   234	
   235	#pragma unroll
   236	    for (int item = 0; item < ITEMS; ++item) {
   237	        const int candidate = tid + item * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
   238	        double candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   239	        if (candidate < point_count && candidate != seed && !clustered[candidate]) {
   240	            const double seed_distance =
   241	                distances[static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count + candidate];
   242	            if (seed_distance < threshold) {
   243	                candidate_diameter = seed_distance;
   244	                takeBetter(seed_distance, candidate, local_choice);
   245	            }
   246	        }
   247	        max_diameters[item] = candidate_diameter;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    if (tid == 0) {
   251	        seed_members[0] = seed;
   252	    }
   253	
   254	    CandidateChoice selected = blockArgMin<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(
   255	        local_choice, shared_diameters, shared_indices);
   256	    int cardinality = 1;
   257	
   258	    while (selected.index != INT_MAX) {
   259	        const int newest_member = selected.index;
   260	        if (tid == 0) {
   261	            seed_members[cardinality] = newest_member;
   262	        }
   263	        ++cardinality;
   264	
   265	        local_choice = CandidateChoice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};
   266	#pragma unroll
   267	        for (int item = 0; item < ITEMS; ++item) {
   268	            const int candidate = tid + item * CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
   269	            double candidate_diameter = max_diameters[item];
   270	            if (candidate == newest_member) {
   271	                candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   272	            } else if (candidate_diameter < threshold) {
   273	                const double new_distance =
   274	                    distances[static_cast<size_t>(newest_member) * point_count + candidate];
   275	                candidate_diameter = max(candidate_diameter, new_distance);
   276	                // Diameter only increases, so an invalid candidate can be
   277	                // permanently discarded from all subsequent iterations.
   278	                if (candidate_diameter >= threshold) {
   279	                    candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   280	                } else {
   281	                    takeBetter(candidate_diameter, candidate, local_choice);
   282	                }
   283	            }
   284	            max_diameters[item] = candidate_diameter;
   285	        }
   286	
   287	        selected = blockArgMin<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(
   288	            local_choice, shared_diameters, shared_indices);
   289	    }
   290	
   291	    if (tid == 0) {
   292	        // Higher cardinality wins; bitwise-inverted seed makes the lower seed
   293	        // win ties under a single deterministic atomicMax.
   294	        const unsigned long long packed =
   295	            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(cardinality) << 32) |
   296	            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
   297	        atomicMax(best_cluster, packed);
   298	    }
   299	}
   300	
   301	// Arbitrary-size fallback. It retains exactly the same GPU algorithm, placing
   302	// the per-seed running maxima in global memory once register tiling is no longer
   303	// practical. There is intentionally no CPU execution path.
   304	__global__ __launch_bounds__(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE)
   305	void growCandidateClustersGlobal(const double* __restrict__ distances,
   306	                                 double* __restrict__ working_diameters,
   307	                                 unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   308	                                 const int* __restrict__ active_seeds,
   309	                                 const int point_count,
   310	                                 const double threshold,
   311	                                 unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,
   312	                                 int* __restrict__ candidate_members) {
   313	    const int active_index = blockIdx.x;
   314	    const int seed = active_seeds[active_index];
   315	    if (clustered[seed]) {
   316	        return;
   317	    }
   318	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
   319	    int* const seed_members =
   320	        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
   321	    double* const seed_diameters =
   322	        working_diameters + static_cast<size_t>(active_index) * point_count;
   323	
   324	    __shared__ double shared_diameters[32];
   325	    __shared__ int shared_indices[32];
   326	
   327	    CandidateChoice local_choice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};
   328	    for (int candidate = tid; candidate < point_count;
   329	         candidate += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
   330	        double candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   331	        if (candidate != seed && !clustered[candidate]) {
   332	            const double seed_distance =
   333	                distances[static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count + candidate];
   334	            if (seed_distance < threshold) {
   335	                candidate_diameter = seed_distance;
   336	                takeBetter(seed_distance, candidate, local_choice);
   337	            }
   338	        }
   339	        seed_diameters[candidate] = candidate_diameter;
   340	    }
   341	
   342	    if (tid == 0) {
   343	        seed_members[0] = seed;
   344	    }
   345	
   346	    CandidateChoice selected = blockArgMin<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(
   347	        local_choice, shared_diameters, shared_indices);
   348	    int cardinality = 1;
   349	
   350	    while (selected.index != INT_MAX) {
   351	        const int newest_member = selected.index;
   352	        if (tid == 0) {
   353	            seed_members[cardinality] = newest_member;
   354	        }
   355	        ++cardinality;
   356	
   357	        local_choice = CandidateChoice{INVALID_DISTANCE, INT_MAX};
   358	        for (int candidate = tid; candidate < point_count;
   359	             candidate += CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
   360	            double candidate_diameter = seed_diameters[candidate];
   361	            if (candidate == newest_member) {
   362	                candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   363	            } else if (candidate_diameter < threshold) {
   364	                const double new_distance =
   365	                    distances[static_cast<size_t>(newest_member) * point_count + candidate];
   366	                candidate_diameter = max(candidate_diameter, new_distance);
   367	                if (candidate_diameter >= threshold) {
   368	                    candidate_diameter = INVALID_DISTANCE;
   369	                } else {
   370	                    takeBetter(candidate_diameter, candidate, local_choice);
   371	                }
   372	            }
   373	            seed_diameters[candidate] = candidate_diameter;
   374	        }
   375	
   376	        selected = blockArgMin<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>(
   377	            local_choice, shared_diameters, shared_indices);
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    if (tid == 0) {
   381	        const unsigned long long packed =
   382	            (static_cast<unsigned long long>(cardinality) << 32) |
   383	            (0xffffffffull - static_cast<unsigned int>(seed));
   384	        atomicMax(best_cluster, packed);
   385	    }
   386	}
   387	
   388	// Commit the selected row in parallel. All candidate member orders already
   389	// exist on-device, so the winning seed never needs to be grown a second time.
   390	__global__ void commitBestCluster(const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,
   391	                                  const int* __restrict__ candidate_members,
   392	                                  const int point_count,
   393	                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
   394	                                  int* __restrict__ output_members) {
   395	    const unsigned long long packed_best = *best_cluster;
   396	    const int cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
   397	    const int seed = static_cast<int>(
   398	        0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
   399	    const int* const seed_members =
   400	        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
   401	
   402	    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < cardinality; i += blockDim.x) {
   403	        const int member = seed_members[i];
   404	        output_members[i] = member;
   405	        clustered[member] = 1;
   406	    }
   407	}
   408	
   409	void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
   410	                           const int point_count,
   411	                           const double threshold,
   412	                           const double* distances,
   413	                           double* working_diameters,
   414	                           unsigned char* clustered,
   415	                           const int* active_seeds,
   416	                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
   417	                           int* members) {
   418	    const dim3 grid(active_count);
   419	    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
   420	
   421	    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
   422	        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
   423	            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
   424	            best_cluster, members);
   425	    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
   426	        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
   427	            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
   428	            best_cluster, members);
   429	    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
   430	        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
   431	            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
   432	            best_cluster, members);
   433	    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
   434	        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
   435	            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
   436	            best_cluster, members);
   437	    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
   438	        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
   439	            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
   440	            best_cluster, members);
   441	    } else {
   442	        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
   443	            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
   444	            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
   445	    }
   446	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   447	}
   448	
   449	} // namespace
   450	
   451	// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
   452	// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
   453	// work execute on the GPU.
   454	std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   455	                                  const double threshold) {
   455	                                  const double threshold) {
   456	    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   457	    const size_t matrix_elements =
   458	        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
   459	
   460	    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
   461	    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
   462	    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
   463	    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
   464	    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
   465	    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
   466	    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
   467	
   468	    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
   469	    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
   470	    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
   471	    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
   472	        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
   473	
   474	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
   475	                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   476	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
   477	                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
   478	
   479	    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
   480	    const dim3 distance_grid(
   481	        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
   482	        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
   483	    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
   484	        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
   485	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   486	
   487	    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
   488	    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
   489	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
   490	                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
   491	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   492	
   493	    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
   494	    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
   495	    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
   496	    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
   497	    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
   498	
   499	    int remaining_points = point_count;
   500	    int member_offset = 0;
   501	    while (remaining_points > 0) {
   502	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
   503	                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
   504	
   505	        launchCandidateKernel(
   506	            point_count, point_count, threshold,
   507	            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
   508	            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
   509	            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
   510	
   511	        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   512	            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
   513	            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
   514	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   515	
   516	        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
   517	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
   518	                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   519	        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
   520	        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
   521	            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
   522	
   523	        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
   524	        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
   525	        member_offset += max_cardinality;
   526	        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
   527	    }
   528	
   529	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
   530	                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   531	
   532	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   533	    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
   534	    member_offset = 0;
   535	    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
   536	        Cluster cluster;
   537	        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
   538	        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
   539	        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
   540	                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
   541	        member_offset += cardinality;
   542	        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
   543	    }
   544	
   545	    return clusters;
   546	}

+// CUDA calls are deliberately fatal: this benchmark has no sequential fallback.
+// A CUDA failure therefore cannot silently change the parallelization approach.
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \

+        const cudaError_t cuda_status_ = (call);                                \
+        if (cuda_status_ != cudaSuccess) {                                      \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__,       \
+                         __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(cuda_status_));            \

+template <typename T>
+class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(const size_t count) : count_(count) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    T* get() { return data_; }
+    const T* get() const { return data_; }
+    size_t size() const { return count_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t count_ = 0;
+};

+namespace {
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+constexpr double INVALID_DISTANCE = DBL_MAX;
+
+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+}
+
+struct CandidateChoice {
+    double diameter;
+    int index;
+};
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void takeBetter(const double other_diameter,
+                                           const int other_index,
+                                           CandidateChoice& choice) {
+    if (other_diameter < choice.diameter ||
+        (other_diameter == choice.diameter && other_index < choice.index)) {
+        choice.diameter = other_diameter;
+        choice.index = other_index;
+    }
+}
+
+// Deterministic (diameter, point-index) reduction. Using the index as the
+// secondary key exactly preserves the sequential scan's first-point tie break.
+template <int BLOCK_SIZE>
+__device__ __forceinline__ CandidateChoice blockArgMin(
+    CandidateChoice choice, double* shared_diameters, int* shared_indices) {
+    constexpr int WARP_SIZE = 32;
+    constexpr int WARP_COUNT = (BLOCK_SIZE + WARP_SIZE - 1) / WARP_SIZE;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / WARP_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        const double other_diameter =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, choice.diameter, offset);
+        const int other_index =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, choice.index, offset);
+        takeBetter(other_diameter, other_index, choice);
+    }
+
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        shared_diameters[warp] = choice.diameter;
+        shared_indices[warp] = choice.index;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+

+// Commit the selected row in parallel. All candidate member orders already
+// exist on-device, so the winning seed never needs to be grown a second time.
+__global__ void commitBestCluster(const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_cluster,

+                                  const int point_count,
+                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,

+        candidate_members + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count;
+
+    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < cardinality; i += blockDim.x) {
+        const int member = seed_members[i];

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           const double* distances,
+                           double* working_diameters,
+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,
+                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
+                           int* members) {
+    const dim3 grid(active_count);
+    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
+        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
+        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else {
+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}
+
+} // namespace

+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());
+
+    int remaining_points = point_count;
+    int member_offset = 0;
+    while (remaining_points > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_best_cluster.get(), 0,
+                              sizeof(unsigned long long)));
+
+        launchCandidateKernel(
+            point_count, point_count, threshold,
+            device_distances.get(), device_working_diameters.get(),
+            device_clustered.get(), device_active_seeds.get(),
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get());
+
+        commitBestCluster<<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+
+        cluster_seeds.push_back(best_seed);
+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
+        member_offset += max_cardinality;
+        remaining_points -= max_cardinality;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_members.data(), device_output_members.get(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    clusters.reserve(cluster_seeds.size());
+    member_offset = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_seeds.size(); ++i) {
+        Cluster cluster;
+        cluster.seed_point = cluster_seeds[i];
+        const int cardinality = cluster_cardinalities[i];
+        cluster.members.assign(host_members.begin() + member_offset,
+                               host_members.begin() + member_offset + cardinality);
+        member_offset += cardinality;
+        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));
+    }
+
     return clusters;
 }

Key changes:

- GPU-parallel distance-matrix construction and seed-cluster growth.
- One CUDA block per seed with warp-level deterministic reductions.
- Register-resident incremental diameter tracking for inputs up to 4,096 points.
- CUDA global-memory fallback for larger inputs.
- Exact original tie-breaking and cluster membership ordering.

+// CUDA calls are deliberately fatal: this benchmark has no sequential fallback.
+// A CUDA failure therefore cannot silently change the parallelization approach.
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \
+    do {                                                                        \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_status_ = (call);                                \
+        if (cuda_status_ != cudaSuccess) {                                      \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__,       \
+                         __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(cuda_status_));            \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                            \
+        }                                                                       \
+    } while (false)
+
+template <typename T>
+class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(const size_t count) : count_(count) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+
+    ~DeviceBuffer() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+
+    T* get() { return data_; }
+    const T* get() const { return data_; }
+    size_t size() const { return count_; }
+
+private:
+    T* data_ = nullptr;
+    size_t count_ = 0;
+};

+// Precomputing exact Euclidean distances turns the repeatedly evaluated square
+// roots in QT's inner loop into coalesced reads. The full matrix is intentional:
+// selected-member rows are then contiguous for every candidate-cluster block.
+__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                    double* __restrict__ distances,
+                                    const int point_count) {
+    const int candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const int member = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (candidate >= point_count || member >= point_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[member].x;
+    const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[member].y;
+    distances[static_cast<size_t>(member) * point_count + candidate] =
+        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+}

+void launchCandidateKernel(const int active_count,
+                           const int point_count,
+                           const double threshold,
+                           const double* distances,
+                           double* working_diameters,
+                           unsigned char* clustered,
+                           const int* active_seeds,
+                           unsigned long long* best_cluster,
+                           int* members) {
+    const dim3 grid(active_count);
+    const dim3 block(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        growCandidateClusters<1><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 2) {
+        growCandidateClusters<2><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 4) {
+        growCandidateClusters<4><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 8) {
+        growCandidateClusters<8><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else if (point_count <= CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16) {
+        growCandidateClusters<16><<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, clustered, active_seeds, point_count, threshold,
+            best_cluster, members);
+    } else {
+        growCandidateClustersGlobal<<<grid, block>>>(
+            distances, working_diameters, clustered, active_seeds,
+            point_count, threshold, best_cluster, members);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+}

+// Main QT clustering algorithm. Each outer iteration retains the original
+// commit ordering, while every active seed and all of its candidate scoring
+// work execute on the GPU.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t matrix_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(point_count) * static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> device_clustered(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active_seeds(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_candidate_members(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_output_members(points.size());
+    DeviceBuffer<unsigned long long> device_best_cluster(1);
+
+    // Above 4096 points register tiling gives way to an N-by-N GPU workspace.
+    // Allocate a one-element dummy otherwise so kernel dispatch stays simple.
+    const bool use_global_workspace = point_count > CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE * 16;
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_working_diameters(
+        use_global_workspace ? matrix_elements : 1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          points.size() * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered.get(), 0,
+                          points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrix<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    std::vector<int> active_seeds(points.size());
+    std::iota(active_seeds.begin(), active_seeds.end(), 0);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_seeds.get(), active_seeds.data(),
+                          active_seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    std::vector<int> host_members(points.size());
+    std::vector<int> cluster_seeds;
+    std::vector<int> cluster_cardinalities;
+    cluster_seeds.reserve(points.size());
+    cluster_cardinalities.reserve(points.size());

+            device_best_cluster.get(), device_candidate_members.get(), point_count,
+            device_clustered.get(), device_output_members.get() + member_offset);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        unsigned long long packed_best = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&packed_best, device_best_cluster.get(),
+                              sizeof(packed_best), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        const int max_cardinality = static_cast<int>(packed_best >> 32);
+        const int best_seed = static_cast<int>(
+            0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned int>(packed_best));
+

+        cluster_cardinalities.push_back(max_cardinality);
